claims.statement: Add a read-only possibility-ecology projection: for one goal or opportunity, list direct candidate opportunities with authored dimensions, realization state, goal links, one-hop explicit relations and claims explicitly shared by multiple candidates. It introduces no inference, ranking, synthesis, controller or new schema; it is not the full assumption-aware opportunity ecology, whose independent experience remains NOT_ASSESSED.

attributes.scope: One goal or opportunity subject; direct candidate edges; one explicit relationship hop per candidate; at most eight relationships per candidate and ten shared links
attributes.decision_changed: An agent can inspect authored candidate dimensions, realization states, goal links and shared co-references through one bounded query instead of intersecting raw JSON or generic graph edges manually.
attributes.claim_ceiling: One implementation and local/hosted mechanical probes. Existing generic knowledge-view-export and explain can retrieve raw edges; no independent benefit, comparative improvement, full ecology experience or selection authority is established.
attributes.counterevidence: docs/normal-use/2026-11-02-creative-prospective-discovery.md (baseline bb77dac) provisionally preferred agent-native relational discovery and retained bounded deterministic graph-assistance only if actual cases show existing search/explain/context-for cannot retrieve needed shared-premise or multi-option neighborhoods. Raw edges are retrievable through the later generic graph view and explain, so the condition is not met as a strict retrieval inability. The projection is warranted here by the owner's current capability-construction mandate and an actual strategic-selection consumer, not by an inability claim; its added value is authored dimensions and shared-link aggregation with lower synthesis overhead. Reconsider or remove it if sustained use does not justify that overhead reduction.

attributes.scope: Read-only prospective projection within the query capability

attributes.relationship: bounded data-access slice; the full assumption-aware ecology and its independent experience remain NOT_ASSESSED
